targetTexts.1: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
targetTexts.2: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
targetTexts.3: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
targetTexts.4: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
targetTexts.5: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
targetTexts.6: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
targetTexts.7: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
targetTexts.8: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
targetTexts.9: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
targetTexts.10: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
targetTexts.11: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
targetTexts.12: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
targetTexts.13: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
targetTexts.14: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
targetTexts.15: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
targetTexts.16: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
targetTexts.17: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
targetTexts.18: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
targetTexts.19: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
targetTexts.20: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
targetTexts.21: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
targetTexts.22: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
targetTexts.23: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
targetTexts.24: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
targetTexts.25: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
targetTexts.26: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
targetTexts.27: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
targetTexts.28: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
targetTexts.29: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
targetTexts.30: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
targetTexts.31: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
targetTexts.32: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
targetTexts.33: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
targetTexts.34: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
targetTexts.35: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
targetTexts.36: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
targetTexts.37: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
targetTexts.38: He blesses them, and they multiply greatly; He does not let their herds diminish.
targetTexts.39: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
targetTexts.40: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
targetTexts.41: But He lifts the needy from affliction and increases their families like flocks.
targetTexts.42: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
targetTexts.43: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
